<h3 id="multi-task-learning-as-multi-objective-optimization">Multi-Task Learning as Multi-Objective Optimization</h3>
<ul>
<li>arxiv：<a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/1810.04650" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://arxiv.org/abs/1810.04650</a></li>
<li>来源：合作者提到的论文，用 multi-objective 的方式来解决 multi-task 问题。NeurIPS 2018。</li>
<li>（感觉对 RL 来说，如果 multi-task 的 task 之间 transition 相同，只有 reward 不同，那么问题 setting 好像跟 multi-objective 挺像的（）</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="multi-type-preference-learning-empowering-preference-based-reinforcement-learning-with-equal-preferences">Multi-Type Preference Learning: Empowering Preference-Based Reinforcement Learning with Equal Preferences</h3>
<ul>
<li>来源：无意中搜到的。ICRA 2025。</li>
<li>arxiv：<a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.07268" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.07268</a></li>
<li>GitHub：<a href="https://github.com/FeiCuiLengMMbb/paper_MTPL" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/FeiCuiLengMMbb/paper_MTPL</a></li>
<li>好奇是不是 multi-type + PbRL。</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="metacure-meta-reinforcement-learning-with-empowerment-driven-exploration">MetaCURE: Meta Reinforcement Learning with Empowerment-Driven Exploration</h3>
<ul>
<li>arxiv：<a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2006.08170" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://arxiv.org/abs/2006.08170</a></li>

</ul>

<li>主要内容：</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="few-is-more-task-efficient-skill-discovery-for-multi-task-offline-multi-agent-reinforcement-learning">Few is More: Task-Efficient Skill-Discovery for Multi-Task Offline Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning</h3>
<ul>
<li>arxiv：<a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.08985" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.08985</a></li>
<li>来源：同学的最新工作。</li>
<li>主要内容：
<ul>
<li>这篇文章关注的 setting 是 offline multi-task MARL；特别的，agent 只在（比如说）三个人合作的场景上训练，然后就可以泛化到任意多个人合作的场景。同学讲的故事是，用 transformer 作为一个翻译器，把三个人的合作动作翻译为多个人的，感觉这个故事听起来非常好。</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="rethinking-reward-modeling-in-preference-based-large-language-model-alignment">Rethinking Reward Modeling in Preference-based Large Language Model Alignment</h3>
<ul>
<li>arxiv：<a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.04991" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.04991</a></li>
<li>OpenReview：<a href="https://openreview.net/forum?id=rfdblE10qm" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://openreview.net/forum?id=rfdblE10qm</a></li>
<li>来源：ICLR 2025 oral。</li>
<li>主要内容：
<ul>
<li>这篇文章关注 LLM 的 RLHF。据说不采用 bradley-terry model 来建模 reward model，而是直接训一个分类器，学习一个 (x,y) 是好的还剩坏的，然后使用分类器的概率 logit 作为 RLHF 的 reward。</li>
<li>是否使用了非成对的比较 <span class="math inline">\((x_1, y_1^+, x_2, y_2^-)\)</span>，而非把成对比较 <span class="math inline">\((x, y^+, y^-)\)</span> 打乱（？）</li>
<li>实验是否过于 toy（？）理论大概说了什么（？）</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="dopl-direct-online-preference-learning-for-restless-bandits-with-preference-feedback">DOPL: Direct Online Preference Learning for Restless Bandits with Preference Feedback</h3>

<li>来源：合作者推荐的文章。</li>
<li>主要内容：
<ul>
<li>preference-based index policy（？）</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>whittle index，一个结论，两个等价条件，经典问题的证明方式。</li>
</ul>
